thread:
maria-support: FYI — Acme SRE reports client-side JSON parse failures for streaming responses. They see 'Unexpected end of JSON input' after the last SSE chunk. Happens ~5% of streams across eu-west and us-west, started 2026-03-14 ~02:10 UTC.

ken-eng: Do we have a repro and request headers + model name? Any request-id they can share?

maria-support: They provided a minimal curl repro and a sample trace-id. Model: gpt-4o-infer (hosted). Trace-id: rwd-req-549111. curl: 

```bash
curl -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streaming/generate \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-infer","input":"Summarize this long doc...","stream":true}'
```

maria-support: Client shows last SSE events like this (joined lines):

```
data: {"delta":{"content":"...final token"}}


data: {"delta":{}}

```

and then connection closes abruptly. No final `data: [DONE]` or `finish_reason`. Client's JS throws SyntaxError when it tries to assemble final JSON after reconnect.

jules-eng: I pulled the request traces for rwd-req-549111. Backend model process returned final tokens and signaled completion, but our proxy (fastly/nginx edge) logged an upstream closed connection before we wrote the terminal event frame. Relevant nginx upstream log: `upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream` for backend host gpu-12.

infra-bot: Correlated: there were 2x keepalive resets from the TPU/GPU host during that window and one socket timeout on the health checker. No deploys recorded in that minute.

ken-eng: Two likely failure modes: 1) proxy or load-balancer dropped the TCP connection before our code flushed the final SSE event (so client sees abrupt EOF), or 2) our SSE framing code wrote the final event but the edge trimmed trailing bytes. We need to confirm whether the model runner emitted the finish marker. Jules, can you paste the runner stdout fragment with request id?

jules-eng: Runner stdout for rwd-req-549111 shows final log lines: `emit_token: idx=534 token="."`, then `session_close: status=OK, tokens=535`, but I don't see an explicit "emit_finish_event" log because our SSE flush occurs in the proxy write path.

maria-support: Customer says they also tried reconnect logic: when they reconnect with resume headers they get a truncated JSON (missing trailing braces) — they interpret it as a codec bug in our SSE.

ops-oncall: Suggest immediate mitigation: 1) ask client to tolerate EOF and treat last buffered text as final when finish_reason absent (we can provide guidance snippet). 2) temporarily increase proxy timeouts and disable keepalive reuse for streaming backends in eu-west and us-west.

ken-eng: For reproducibility, ask the customer to run this short node snippet that tolerates abrupt EOF: 

```js
const es = new EventSource(url, {headers: {Authorization: `Bearer ${KEY}`}})
es.onmessage = (e) => { if (e.data === '[DONE]') done=true; else buffer += e.data }
es.onerror = (err) => { // if stream closed and buffer non-empty, treat as finished 
  if (!done && buffer.length) handle(buffer)
}
```

jules-eng: I'll add extra logging in the streaming write path to emit "write_flush_done" with bytes_sent and final_frame_marker for the request id. Also scheduling infra change to bump proxy read timeout from 30s -> 60s for streaming routes.

deploy-bot: No streaming-route deploys in the last 24h. Rolling config change proposed for proxy timeouts (candidate: ENG-INFRA-453).

maria-support: I'll send the node snippet to the customer and tell them we are investigating the edge. Customer asked if this is a billing/quota issue — they have ample quota and no auth errors, so not billing.

ken-eng: Action items: 
- Jules: instrument runner+write path logs for rwd-req-549111 and similar ids.
- Infra: correlate fastly logs for edge host and check for truncated chunked responses.
- Support: share mitigation snippet with customer; ask for two more trace-ids if they see it again.

maria-support: Escalation created ENG-INFRA-453. I'll update thread when infra posts logs. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Noted. I'll attach fastly request logs and socket traces once pulled (ETA ~60m).

maria-support: Customer replied: "Thanks — we'll add EOF-tolerant parsing client-side and report back if we see it after the change."

ken-eng: If we confirm proxy-side drops we should consider adding an explicit final sentinel event from the model runner that we flush before socket close (e.g., `data: {"type":"final","finish_reason":"stop"}`). That will make clients more resilient.

maria-support: Closing loop for now — tracking under ENG-INFRA-453.
